# DIRECTION — 02-atelier-printworks

## Design thesis
Atelier Møn Printworks is a night-watch instrument: first screen is the work journey (“enquire about a print edition.”), not marketing chrome; ban generic creative-agency blob gradients, stock loft photos. Composition: single object left, large type right.

## Subject grounding
Subject: Atelier Møn Printworks
Audience: curators and small brands commissioning limited runs.
Primary action: enquire about a print edition.
Products/work: letterpress posters, map editions, shop bags for island shops
Brand palette cues: chalk white, harbour ink, coral registration mark
Anti-references: generic creative-agency blob gradients, stock loft photos; generic creative-agency blob gradients, stock loft photos.

## Hierarchy
1) work object 2) required fields/states 3) enquire about a print edition. 4) validation/offline/success — no KPI theatre

## Signature
Always-on status strip + primary work canvas for Atelier Møn Printworks — amber only for faults

## Primary risk
Must not drift into banned tropes (generic creative-agency blob gradients, stock loft photos; generic creative-agen); signature may overfit if evidence is thin.

## Axis record

- direction-version: 2.3
- composition: single object left, large type right
- type: Display: Fraunces or similar display serif for edition titles. Body: Source Serif / Source Sans pair for reading length. Utility: tabular figures for edition sizes only. Seed structure: condensed display grotesque over quiet sans.
- colour: chalk white; type/rules in harbour ink; accent only on primary CTA/hardware (coral registration mark). Seed note: chalk white, harbour ink, coral registration mark — brand evidence only; single reserved accent
- imagery: diagram-led or edition-sheet slots until declared plates exist; no invented photography — only assets listed in plan/manifest; no invented photography.
- rhythm: hard vertical split then calm bands

- surface: open — subject earns space around the object
- labels: sentence case captions — retail voice stays human
- figures: proportional — price is content not motif
- depth: elevated — object lifts off ground slightly

- visual-density: 4
- motion-intensity: 3
- aesthetic-boldness: 7

- signature-selector: [data-signature="Always-on status strip + primary work canvas for Atelier Møn Printworks — amber only for faults"]
- signature-min-share: 12
